technique_name: Identify the five most popular languages in North America.
description: The five most popular languages in North America are English, Spanish, French, Indigenous languages and Chinese. These five languages account for 81.3% of the total languages spoken in North America. English is the most spoken language in North America, spoken by over 66% of the population. Spanish is the second most spoken language in North America, used by 22.1% of the population. French is the third most spoken language in North America, used by 4.9% of the population.
